api.completion: Returns a local candidate attempt record; only observes a verified original COMPLETE receipt, never issues one.

basis: Finite slots, held identities, pre-created ledger, fresh revocation/time checks from F2; NEW heterogeneous ABI and callbacks; no historical F2 PASS transfer.
kept_guards: Canonical immutable REQUEST/BOUND/original documents; actual question/owner provenance is verified externally. Candidate ABI cannot substitute an existing binder.
Identifiable canonical context plus operation key consumes before clock/authority/time/source/dependency gates; changing REQUEST or authority hash cannot reopen the operation.

Persistent O_EXCL consumed marker, fsync, pre-created O_NOFOLLOW ledger, held ancestors and names, exclusive claim append, chained records. Busy, torn, refused, late, missing-adapter and uncertain outcomes retain consumption.
Per-operation finite window and budget, UTC/monotonic skew guard, pure final guard after all callbacks; no retry/catch-up/resume/fallback.
Exact fresh real originals of dependencies and trusted ABI/provenance verifier before effect; changed bytes, future time, wrong context, PENDING refuse.
Authority and physical identity callbacks are required and must raise on absence/revocation/concurrency/pin divergence. Returning a boolean is refused.
Fresh real ALLOW veto with independently verified authority, evidence and <=5s age at final instant. No emitter, config materializer or invented veto supplied.
Reader capacity/ready gate after all other callbacks; pure time/pin/veto guard afterwards. Snapshot clock is re-read after callback delays.
Before first reader: daily_capacity, one capacity-prepared:D journal record, exact manifest, READY and session-root/symbols. sessions.capacity_binding is optional if absent, must match if present.
After first reader cycle: same exact persisted sessions.capacity_binding is required; delayed post-cycle verifier cannot mark completion after deadline.
Consistent DB snapshot and original receipt verification remain external real callbacks. Decoder bound is explicit 16MiB for DB state/journal; manifest/receipt remain 64KiB.

lanes.name: DOWNSTREAM_AFTER_E6
lanes.preconditions: P commit_result and publish_launch exact real COMPLETE originals of the same track/context already present before REQUEST preparation, question/Assino and BOUND. Own authority/slots/source pins; dependency selectors explicitly authorized, actual receipt reader verifies each before effect. No future SHA.

material_limits: No executor, SSH/SQL/Docker/host adapter, installer, real timer, receipt issuer, authority issuer, signature, GO or operational job is supplied or executed.
Injected callbacks are a trust boundary. Operational code must pin and independently verify them; a callback that falsely attests is not made trustworthy by this core.
Core supplies deadline to executor and checks return; it cannot interrupt a hung callback. The new real launcher must enforce an actual bounded transport/process budget.
Durability is proven only for local fsync/marker/ledger fixtures. Deleting/replaying both objects, whole-root rollback and host crash persistence require independent witness and real proof.
Unknown/unparseable input or unelected/replaced ledger cannot safely record an attempt; it authorizes no effect or retry. No recovery path is provided.
16MiB DB ceiling is a candidate explicit memory/transport budget, not a demonstrated physical maximum of the actual DB or journal.
Semantic task labels are a new candidate ABI; they do not claim existing P/E6/K13/POST/reader/capture command compatibility.
Actual times/capture choices, Monday human availability, narrowed critical gates and scope cut need exact actual owner/documentary authority; no ETA or future Monday entry is certified.

minimum_remaining_programs_and_gates.needed: Upstream own final inputs; downstream built only after real commit_result/publish_launch originals. Immutability after Assino. No placeholder/future digest.
New exact source/service pins; own root/ledger election, readback, no catchup/retry, fixed slots/deadlines, bounded effects and teardown. No real units or timer generator included.
Host-independent witness/current election blocks reset or deletion of both ledger and consumed markers. Local hash chain cannot prove its own rollback resistance.
Actual UID/boot/Python/image/release/calendar/config/source/root identities immediately before effect, with held descriptors and original logs. None supplied by fixture callbacks.
